name: think-snippets
description: Real, runnable Cloudflare Project Think snippets. Deploy a native Think Durable Object, prove its chat memory and durable programmatic submissions, then destroy it.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:buttons
scripts.deploy:personal: STAGE=personal bash scripts/personal-env.sh npx alchemy deploy --stage personal
scripts.destroy:personal: STAGE=personal bash scripts/personal-env.sh npx alchemy destroy --stage personal
